basics.name: Hubert Jędrzejek
basics.label: Senior Laravel Developer | Legacy Code Modernization | 15+ Years in PHP
basics.summary:
Senior Laravel developer with over 15 years of PHP experience. I modernize legacy systems — incrementally, without risky full rewrites.

Most legacy projects don't need to be rebuilt from scratch. They need someone who can step-by-step modernize them, reduce technical debt, and deliver value along the way. That's exactly what I do.

Currently working on migrating RPG/AS400 systems to Laravel. Previously transformed Drupal applications into modern, maintainable solutions. Different starting points, same approach: practical modernization that works with the framework.

work.name: ESCOLA S.A.
work.summary: Modernizing a 40-year-old mainframe system to Laravel for a US-based organization serving hundreds of thousands of users. The legacy system handled most operational processes with hundreds of millions of records.
highlights: Applying strangler fig pattern for gradual migration without downtime
Building data synchronization layer between old and new systems
Reverse engineering undocumented business logic through code and data analysis
Designing Laravel architecture for migrated modules
Maintaining operational continuity while replacing a critical system with no documentation or test environment

work.summary: Working across healthcare, automotive sectors and internal products. Laravel, Laravel Nova, Lumen, Java, Spring.

Migrated legacy Drupal application to Laravel in automotive sector
Built vehicle data processing layer handling both SOAP and REST APIs
